# Chat Model

This file defines the Mongoose schema and model for managing chat conversations and messages within the application.

## Overview

The Chat model is responsible for storing and retrieving chat data, including participant information and the history of messages exchanged between users. It interacts with the User model through references.

<CardGroup cols={2}>
  <Card title="Participants" icon="👥">
    Stores ObjectIDs referencing the `User` model for each participant in a chat.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Messages" icon="💬">
    Contains an array of message objects, each with sender information and text content.
  </Card>
</CardGroup>

## Chat Schema

The `chatSchema` defines the structure of a chat document in the MongoDB collection.

### Participants

<ParamField name="participants" type="Array<ObjectId>" required>
  An array of ObjectIDs, each referencing a `User` document. These represent the users involved in the chat conversation.
</ParamField>

### Messages

<ParamField name="messages" type="Array<Object>" required>
  An array of message objects, where each object conforms to the `messageSchema`.
  <Expandable title="messageSchema properties">
    <ParamField name="senderId" type="ObjectId" required>
      The ID of the user who sent the message. This is a reference to the `User` model.
    </ParamField>
    <ParamField name="text" type="String" required>
      The content of the message.
    </ParamField>
    <ParamField name="createdAt" type="Date">
      Timestamp indicating when the message was created. Automatically managed by Mongoose.
    </ParamField>
    <ParamField name="updatedAt" type="Date">
      Timestamp indicating when the message was last updated. Automatically managed by Mongoose.
    </ParamField>
  </Expandable>
</ParamField>

## Model Export

The `Chat` model is exported for use in other parts of the application.

```javascript
const mongoose = require("mongoose");

const messageSchema = new mongoose.Schema(
    {
        senderId: {
            type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
            ref: "User",
            required: true,
        },

        text: {
            type: String,
            required: true,
        },
    },
    { timestamps: true }
)

const chatSchema = new mongoose.Schema(
    {
        participants: [
            { type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: "User", required: true },
        ],
        messages: [messageSchema]
    }
)

const Chat = mongoose.model("Chat", chatSchema);

module.exports =  { Chat }
```

## Usage

This model is typically imported and used within `src/routes/chat.js` to manage chat-related operations, such as creating new chats, adding messages, and retrieving chat history.

```javascript
// Example usage in src/routes/chat.js (conceptual)
const { Chat } = require('../models/chat');
const { User } = require('../models/user'); // Assuming User model is available

// ... (other route handlers)

// To create a new chat
async function createChat(userId1, userId2) {
  const newChat = new Chat({
    participants: [userId1, userId2],
    messages: []
  });
  await newChat.save();
  return newChat;
}

// To add a message to an existing chat
async function addMessageToChat(chatId, senderId, messageText) {
  const updatedChat = await Chat.findByIdAndUpdate(
    chatId,
    {
      $push: {
        messages: { senderId: senderId, text: messageText }
      }
    },
    { new: true }
  );
  return updatedChat;
}
```
